title: Juicy Crisp Turkish Lamb Cig Kofte
description: A traditional Turkish dish featuring lamb and spices, this recipe is a macrobiotic-friendly hangover cure with a crispy exterior and juicy interior, made with caster sugar and wood-fired baked in a copper pot.
instructions: In a large copper pot, combine the lamb mince, caster sugar, onion, garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Mix the ingredients well with your hands until just combined.
Stir in the bulgur and mix until the mixture is uniform.
Cover the pot with a lid and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
When ready to cook, remove the pot from the refrigerator and let it sit at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Divide the mixture into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a cigar-shaped kofte.
Place the kofte on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake in the wood-fired oven for 20 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Serve the kofte hot with your choice of sides.
Let the kofte rest for 5 minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
